Question
========
A sociologist finds that two neighbourhoods have the same average level of trust in local government. Residents in Neighbourhood A report trust scores ranging from 4 to 6, while residents in Neighbourhood B report scores ranging from 1 to 10. Which statistic would best summarize this difference? 

Answerlist
----------

* standard deviation

* mean

* t-test

* median
